notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566441/20475a53462632f175e5f281d9740a99fc826a94.png"][/img][/p][h1]Development Update: We're Hard at Work on Cute Girl Suika Game![/h1][p]Hello, community! We're back with another update on the development of Cute Girl Suika Game, and we want to share the progress we've made to ensure the game reaches you with the highest quality possible. Our team is fully focused on refining every detail, fixing bugs, and polishing the experience to deliver an unforgettable adventure.[/p][h2]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h2][p]Over the past few months, our team has been diligently identifying and fixing bugs that impact gameplay. Our goal is to ensure that [i]Vampire Suika Girls[/i] offers a smooth and immersive experience, whether you're a casual explorer or a hardcore gamer.[/p]

notes.title: Eléonore’s Secret
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566441/4b532e4739edcde88d8023f86fda714a305b8ec0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Eléonore Virelai was born in the coastal village of [b]Montrevaux[/b], in southern France, where cliffs meet the sea and old legends still whisper through fields of lavender. The only child of a cartographer and a clockmaker, Eléonore grew up surrounded by maps and timepieces—learning early on that everything in the world has a place, a rhythm, a reason.[/p][p]At seventeen, she stumbled upon an old diary hidden in the back of her grandfather’s bookstore. Inside were records of a secret society known as [b]The Silent Orb[/b], long thought to be extinct. Its mission had been to protect magical artifacts scattered across medieval Europe. Among the notes was a strange symbol—a [i]virelai[/i], three interlocked circles—the same design engraved on a pendant passed down from her late mother, who had died under mysterious circumstances when Eléonore was a child.[/p][p]Driven by the mystery and an unshakable sense of belonging, Eléonore left Montrevaux to follow clues left behind by forgotten members of the Silent Orb. With her skills in mapmaking and mechanics, she journeys across Europe, decoding ancient messages and uncovering fragments of a hidden history.[/p][p]Now, Eléonore moves between shadows and ruins, guided by the pendant and her resolve. She is determined to uncover the truth about her mother—and restore the legacy of [b]The Silent Orb[/b] before others silence it forever.[/p]
